title: The Job — Sc119: Nicole close-up that punch-zooms into an extreme face shot

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Emotion close-up with an in-scene camera punch: the shot opens as a medium close-up of Nicole against a blurred room background ('background 1st'), then smash-zooms around frame 15 into an extreme close-up where her eyes and mouth fill the entire 16:9 frame over flat blue ('background Last'). One character layer (MOM) the whole time — the 'cut' is a scale/background swap inside the scene, and the scream is carried entirely by the eye/mouth comp system plus a dedicated 'evil mum face' symbol.
notes: Frames 1-8: medium close-up, blurred photographic-style room BG. Frame ~15 onward: extreme close-up, face = the whole frame, flat colour BG.
The two background layers are the before/after of the punch-in — no camera symbol, just a BG swap + puppet scale jump.
Extreme expressions get their own symbol ('evil mum face', 76 kf) instead of being posed on the stock face comps.
Mouth shapes in the extreme section cycle scream -> round 'o' -> clamped shut: the whole beat is lip-sync comps at wall size.
